name: dentalbook-v5
description: Dentalbook v5 private literature web, shared domain service, and agent-friendly MCP interfaces.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dentalbook/domain-contracts && npm run build -w @dentalbook/ui-kit && npm run build -w @dentalbook/mcp-ui && npm run build -w @dentalbook/web && npm run build -w @dentalbook/center-service && npm run build -w @dentalbook/mcp-user && npm run build -w @dentalbook/mcp-admin && npm run build -w @dentalbook/admin-cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dentalbook/center-service && npm run test -w @dentalbook/mcp-user && npm run test -w @dentalbook/mcp-admin && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run validate:json && npm run validate:links && npm run validate:skills && npm run validate:plugin
